title: Pilot should have a structured game log
description:
The pilot currently gets raw XMage text via get_game_log — an unstructured string of game actions mixed with noise (draw step messages, zone move notifications, etc.).

The blunder annotator constructs a much better view: per-turn action history with noise filtered out (_actions_by_turn in blunder_analysis.py). The pilot should have access to something similarly structured, either by enhancing get_game_log to return structured per-turn data with noise filtering, or by adding a new MCP tool.

A structured game log would help pilots:
- Track what opponents have done (spells cast, attacks made, cards played)
- Understand game progression without parsing raw XMage output
- Make better strategic decisions based on opponent behavior patterns
- Know whether a land was played this turn, what spells were countered, etc.

The blunder annotator's _actions_by_turn + _ACTION_NOISE regex is a good starting point for what the structured format should look like.
